sofia_customer: Hi Redwood — Sofia from Meridian Health. We'd like to onboard a custom 'claims-tagger' model for classification and PHI redaction verification. Requirements: private VPC, KMS with HSM, exportable per-entity F1 results, and audit logs. Estimate timeline/cost?

ben_cs: Thanks Sofia! Is the model a fine-tuned open model or a proprietary artifact? Do you have a redacted eval set we can run? Also any SLA needs?

sofia_customer: It's a proprietary fine-tune on an open 13B base. We can share a redacted eval set (~1500 labeled records). SLA: prefer 99.5% uptime, p50 latency under 200ms.

kai_engineer: We support private deploys with HSM-backed KMS. For p50=200ms on 13B recommend dedicated 4xA10G or similar and batching off. We'll run entity-level F1 and a 48h soak. Provide artifact in secure S3 after NDA.

maya_security: Security checklist: SOC2/ISO attestation, redaction proof, transfer NDA, and confirmation no training data ingestion. We'll queue review once docs uploaded.

intake-bot: Ticket created: CS-2026-999 "Meridian: claims-tagger private onboarding". Intake link: https://redwood-internal.example/intake/CS-2026-999

ben_cs: Proposed flow: intake + NDA (2 days), security review (up to 7 days), perf + eval (3 days), canary & enablement (1 week). We'll include a fallback to a distilled 7B to save cost off-peak.

sofia_customer: Sounds good. Can you also surface renewal risk metrics in the health dashboard? We want alerts if accuracy drops >4% or sustained throughput <60% for 14 days.

ben_cs: Yes, we'll add those as health checks in the account dashboard and attach a short post-enable survey to capture feedback. I'll schedule intake call for Tue 11am PT.

sofia_customer: Tue 11am PT works. Attendees: me, our ML lead Arjun, and infra lead Lena. We'll upload artifacts by EOD.

ben_cs: Great — see you on the call. :thumbsup:
